# Contributor handbook

Status: published. Fictional handbook for the fictional
Lanternfish project.

## Introduction

Welcome to Lanternfish. This handbook is assembled from versioned sections
maintained by the Lanternfish maintainers; the generated document is the one to read.

## 1. Conduct

Contributors to Lanternfish treat each other with respect. Disagreements are
about the work, never about the person. The Lanternfish maintainers moderators may remove
participants who do not keep to this.

## 2. Review

Every change to Lanternfish receives a
[review](../glossaries/glossary-core.md#glossary-core-term-review) by one
other contributor, and a change to a release branch is also approved by a
[maintainer](../glossaries/glossary-core.md#glossary-core-term-maintainer)
before it merges.

## 3. Releases

A [release](../glossaries/glossary-core.md#glossary-core-term-release) of
Lanternfish is cut by a
[maintainer](../glossaries/glossary-core.md#glossary-core-term-maintainer)
from a tagged commit whose
[changelog](../glossaries/glossary-core.md#glossary-core-term-changelog)
entry is complete.

## 4. Security

Report security problems to the Lanternfish maintainers privately. A
[disclosure](../glossaries/glossary-core.md#glossary-core-term-disclosure)
is acknowledged within five working days.

## 5. General

This handbook is versioned. Sections are approved, superseded, or retired
independently, and the assembled document is generated from the current
approved set.

## Glossary

- **review**: the reading of a change by someone other than its author before it merges.
- **maintainer**: a contributor with the standing to approve changes and cut releases.
- **release**: a tagged, reproducible snapshot of the project that others may depend on.
- **disclosure**: the private reporting of a security problem before it is made public.
- **changelog**: the list of user-visible changes kept per release.
